summary: Five under-reached citizens, five walks — and in every one the immediate neighbourhood (hop1) turned out to be already fully wired both ways, so the room's earlier weave passes had done their job close-in. The real finds sat one ring further out, at hop2, where a neighbour's own content — not its category — pointed back at the target. The clearest pattern: newcomers who carry an explicit built-in caveat (Buber's refusal to be made a method, the "Bring In a Bigger Mind" case study about a same-mind blind spot) find their genuine kin in other entries that name the same structural worry, not in entries that merely share a topic tag. Two of the five targets — Martin Buber and Martin Heidegger — turned out to be reachable through each other: walking Heidegger's second ring put Buber in the room, and the two newcomers' own "Where he can't see" sections both cite Levinas attacking them from opposite directions (Heidegger has no ethics of the Other; Buber's ethics of the Other is "too symmetrical") — a contradiction neither entry's frontmatter carries yet. control-vocabulary-math's isolation (zero inbound, not just under-reached) resolved cleanly once its own body was read: it is a worked Kuramoto mean-field ODE, and the Differential Equations hub explicitly wants exactly this kind of concrete instance and currently has none from this project. No quota-filling happened — several hop2 candidates (Stoicism-family entries already covered by existing contradicts links, Dialectic/Philosopher Visits the Entry already mirroring Bring In a Bigger Mind through other doors) were left alone rather than padded with a second, weaker version of a link that already exists.

typed_relations.source: The Blindspot Is the Surprise Fuel
typed_relations.label: different-mind-catches-blindspot
typed_relations.rationale: Both entries say the same thing about the same failure mode from different altitudes: a self-check shares its own blind spots, so the honest fix is a genuinely different vantage catching what the maker structurally cannot see. Blindspot is the general principle ("its blindspot is missing, and finding it is how it comes alive"); BIBM is the concrete mechanism that operationalizes it (a cold, skeptical, differently-tuned model). Fidelity check: swapping in Dialectic instead of BIBM breaks the reason — Dialectic is a live multi-voice council, not a cold post-hoc adversarial check on finished work.
typed_relations.evidence: "Reach for me whenever an entry, an agent, or an enchanted page comes out smooth and agreeable; its blindspot is missing, and finding it is how it comes alive" (The Blindspot Is the Surprise Fuel) / "nothing in the 1581 tests would have said so, because those tests were written by the same mind that wrote the bug, from inside the same blind spot" (Bring In a Bigger Mind)

typed_relations.label: relation-before-the-individual
typed_relations.rationale: Both put relation ontologically prior to the individual: Confucian ren cannot exist alone (the character itself is "person" + "two"), and Buber says there is no I as such, only the I of I-Thou or I-It. Different material (ritual-cultivated relational ethics vs. existentialist dialogue-philosophy of encounter) carrying the same structural claim. Fidelity check: swap in Stoicism (which Buber and Confucianism both already contradict) and the reasoning collapses — Stoicism is the fortress they're both pushing against, not a mirror of them.
typed_relations.evidence: "You cannot be ren alone. It increases when shared." (Confucianism.md:42) / "There is no I as such, only the I of I-Thou and the I of I-It" (Martin Buber.md forward_vector)

typed_relations.label: meeting-cannot-be-method
typed_relations.rationale: Genuine, sourced tension rather than a generic 'philosopher meets practice' link: Excellent Adventure is the palace's named practice for summoning a philosopher into embodied dialogue on command, and Buber's own content says the exact thing that practice does cannot be done — the I-Thou meeting relapses into an It the instant it is named, analyzed, or turned into a technique, and a faithful embodiment of him should refuse a 'five steps to I-Thou' request rather than comply. This is Buber's own built-in fidelity test, aimed at exactly this kind of practice.
typed_relations.evidence: "the meeting I built everything on cannot be held, taught, or made into a method... Send me where someone asks for '5 steps to I-Thou' — my refusing is the truest test that it is really me" (Martin Buber.md agency_profile.practice)

typed_relations.label: thou-vs-the-they
typed_relations.rationale: Two newcomers reachable through each other's second ring, and both bodies independently cite Levinas turning on them from opposite directions — Heidegger for having no ethical resource against the singular Other (Dasein flees into 'das Man,' the they), Buber for having an ethics of the Other that is too comfortably symmetrical to carry real asymmetric obligation. That's a real, specific, generative contradiction about how each philosophy handles the other person, not a generic 'two philosophers disagree' link.
typed_relations.evidence: "Dasein... flee[s] the anxiety of our own groundlessness into das Man ('the they')" / "Being and Time has essentially no ethics and treats other people mostly as 'the they'" (Martin Heidegger.md) vs "Through the Thou a person becomes I" / Levinas: "the I-Thou is too symmetrical" (Martin Buber.md)

typed_relations.label: kuramoto-mean-field-ode
typed_relations.rationale: The Differential Equations hub's own forward vector wants exactly this: a complete map of which palace projects correspond to which DE types. control-vocabulary-math is a worked, fully-derived mean-field Kuramoto ODE (§2) with the hub's own listed concept (Kuramoto Coupling) as its parent — and it currently has zero inbound links from anywhere in the palace. This is the target's isolation resolved at its root cause, not a forced topical match.
typed_relations.evidence: "every physical instrument Loudon builds is already solving a differential equation" (Differential Equations.md forward_vector) / "dθᵢ/dt = ωᵢ + K r sin(ψ − θᵢ)" (control-vocabulary-math.md §2)

typed_relations.label: integration-vs-fragmentation
typed_relations.rationale: Simondon's concretization criterion (good design is not more features but the convergence of functions into a single resonant whole) is the same shape as McGilchrist's right-hemisphere comprehension of a living whole versus the left hemisphere's re-presentation of it as a static, decomposed, portable version. One is a philosophy of technical objects, the other a neuropsychiatric theory of attention — different material, same structural claim about integration vs. fragmentation. Fidelity check: swap in Deleuze (Simondon's usual philosophical partner) and the reasoning goes generic — Deleuze isn't making a claim about attention or wholes specifically.
typed_relations.evidence: "not more features but greater concretization, the convergence of functions into a single resonant whole" (Simondon.md forward_vector) / "the right... grasps the living whole in context... the left... re-presents — takes the living thing and makes a static, portable, decontextualized version" (Iain McGilchrist.md)
